conventions.halftone_threshold: 8-bit grey, tileable. out_light = (luminance > map). Map is high at dot centres, so dark tones produce growing black dots. Soft edge: clip((L - map)/soft + 0.5, 0, 1).
conventions.angle_deg: Lattice row direction in image coordinates (x right, y down = clockwise on screen), modulo 90 for dot screens. Line screens are horizontal.
conventions.achieved_vs_params: params = target from the style recipe; achieved = exact value baked into the tile (tiles are made seamless by snapping pitch/angle to a rational lattice).
conventions.blend_hint: Intended blend mode. grain=overlay (128 = neutral); paper/pattern/overlay multiply: 255 = no effect; screen: 0 = no effect.
conventions.tiling: tileable=true assets repeat seamlessly in x and y; tile with np.tile / wrap and crop.
